description: One tender-method to Mode of Payment mapping row for Connector Settings (RT-78, RT-10 D5). A POS sale carrying tenders posts as a paid Sales Invoice with one payment per tender; each tender method is mapped here to an ERPNext Mode of Payment, which must have a company account (finance configuration). Consumed by connector.posting.config.parse_tender_mode_map (fieldnames tender_method/mode_of_payment must match the parser). An unmapped method fails closed (UnmappedTender -> validation): the connector never guesses a payment mode.

fields.label: Tender Method
fields.description: The posting-feed SaleTender.method (RT-10 D2 pilot methods; voucher from RT-1114, settled only once RT-1330 is deployed).

fields.label: ERPNext Mode of Payment
fields.description: The ERPNext Mode of Payment this tender settles through. It must have a default account for the company.

name: RT Tender Mode Map Row
